info.title: Alpha Cargo TMS API
info.description:
The Alpha Cargo TMS API for integrators.

Every server-side request is signed with your organization's API key; see
[Authentication](https://docs.alphacargo.io/tms/authentication).

## Errors

A failed request answers with a non-2xx status and `{ "error": "<message>" }`.
The message is localized per `Accept-Language` (`en`, `th`, `zh`).

Organizations set up for the legacy format, and requests sending
`X-Legacy-Response: true`, get every response in the legacy
envelope instead: HTTP 200 with `{ code, message, data, extra, success }`.
Its `code` is one of:

| code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | Success |
| `1000` | Invalid parameters |
| `1001` | Unknown merchant / missing organization context |
| `1002` | Invalid signature |
| `1003` | Waybill already exists |
| `1004` | Origin could not be matched |
| `1005` | Destination could not be matched |
| `1006` | Waybill not found |
| `1007` | No carrier assigned |
| `1008` | Package already exists |
| `-1` | System error |

tags.name: Waybills
tags.description: Create, query, update and cancel waybills; tracking and labels.

signature.name: api_key
signature.description: Organization API key + HMAC-SHA256 signature. `api_key`, `nonceStr` and `sign` travel beside the business fields: in the JSON body for POST/PATCH/DELETE, in the query string for GET. See https://docs.alphacargo.io/tms/authentication.

bearer.description: Supabase session token of a signed-in user.

error.description: Human-readable message, localized per Accept-Language (en, th, zh).

Waybill.description: A waybill with its recipient, sender and packages. The response carries more fields than listed here; unlisted fields are internal and may change without notice.

code.description: 0 on success; see the error code table.

LegacyEnvelope.description: Legacy response envelope. Always HTTP 200; check `success` and `code`. Used by organizations configured for the legacy format, by requests sending `X-Legacy-Response: true`, and always by POST /api/waybills/{waybillNo}/packages.

post.description: Field names are camelCase for compatibility with early integrations. Without `route_id`, `senderPhone` and the receiver fields (all but `receiverDistrictName`) are required.

schema.description: What to do when `outTradeNo` already exists. `overwrite` (default, also `1`): update it in place, keeping its ID. `return_existing` (`2`): return it unchanged. `reject` (`3`): 409. `return_if_accepted` (`4`): return it once a carrier accepted it, otherwise 422.

mchId.description: Deprecated: legacy merchant ID. Sign with api_key instead.

nonceStr.description: Current time in milliseconds, as a string (signature auth).

sign.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature, 64 uppercase hex characters (signature auth).

outTradeNo.description: Your own order number, the idempotency key. A repeat push is handled per the overwrite query parameter.

owner.description: Deprecated: legacy owner code, mapped to a sender account.

senderPhone.description: Required without route_id. Matched against your registered sender locations (organization units).

piece_count.description: Identical pieces this parcel represents as one lot (default 1). Only honoured with autoSplit=false.

metadata.description: Free-form custom data (e.g. production details for customs), any JSON object up to 8 KB. null clears it on a re-push; leaving it out keeps the stored value.

route_id.description: Derive sender and receiver from the route's first and last stop; the sender and receiver fields become optional.

sender_account.description: The customer account the waybill belongs to, by code or ID.

insurance.description: Insurance. declaredValue is in the organization's billing currency; inputAmount/inputCurrency only record what the customer entered.

autoSplit.description: true: each product unit becomes its own package. false: each parcel is one package carrying piece_count. Defaults to the organization's setting.

volumetricWeight.description: Billing total for the whole waybill.

estimatedWeight.description: Billing total for the whole waybill (kg).

estimatedVolume.description: Billing total for the whole waybill.

400.description: Sender location not found for `senderPhone`, or `senderPhone` missing.

403.description: The `outTradeNo` belongs to another organization, or the request carries no organization context.

422.description: Validation failed (the message names each field), or no carrier assigned (`return_if_accepted`).

schema.description: Waybill number, or your own outTradeNo — both are accepted.
